info.title: Space Together API
info.description:
Interactive Swagger/OpenAPI documentation generated from the Space Together Actix route modules.

Authentication headers used by the backend:
- `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>` for JWT-protected user endpoints.
- `School-Token: <school_access_token>` for `/school/...` tenant routes and school event/timetable routes.
- `x-school-id: <school_id>` is optional tenant context for non-school routes; TenantMiddleware can also infer it from subdomain.

MongoDB ObjectId fields are serialized as strings in API JSON. Many list endpoints accept `filter`, `limit`, `skip`, repeated `field`/`value`, and domain IDs through `RequestQuery`.
